==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a large mansion that is still under construction. The mansion supposedly was once the site where an alien craft landed on Earth. My mom bought the property to keep it out of the hands of those who would abuse it.

The mansion doubles as an academy. We study strange biology textbooks containing images of tentacles and bizarre diseases. I've never seen anything like this before.

There are two people I don't trust at the academy. They are pale blonde twins in simple white clothes. I feel like they are in secretly league with something or someone nefarious.
